notes.title: Optimizations, new options menu and graphical touch ups
notes.content:
Hello,
I've updated the game with a handful of optimizations. This should allow the game to run better on all computers, but in particular lower end computers. Ensure that Ambient occlusion and ambient obscurance is off if you experience lag.

I've replaced the options buttons in the lower left corner with a proper menu.

Lastly, I've made some visual improvements. 

/ Dispersing minds

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hello

I've uploaded a patch to the game fixing some issues with score uploads to the scoreboards. Sometimes scoreboards would not load properly, so scores could not be sent to the Steam scoreboards. Hopefully it should all work now and I apologize for the delay, I was not made aware of the issue until today. :)

Much joy challenging eachother. :)
